source_text: Following general procedure F using 2,2,2‐trifluoro‐N‐(3‐(2‐methoxyphenyl)propyl)acetamide (65.3 mg, 0.25 mmol), B2pin2 (127 mg, 0.50 mmol), [Ir(COD)OMe]2 (2.5 mg, 0.00375 mmol) and dtbpy (2.0 mg, 0.0075 mmol) in THF (1.25 mL). The reaction was stirred at 70 °C for 20 hours before cooling and the solventsremoved. Analysis of crude 1 H NMR using internalstandard 1,2‐dimethoxyethane showed 1:2.0 meta:para borylation in 91% yield.
